arStrings.szText: After completing a {c_important}Nightmare Dungeon{/c}, a {c_important}War's Bounty Chest{/c} will spawn that grants additional rewards.
{icon:Marker_Season_Green_font,2.5}At Rank {c_number}4{/c} with the {c_important}Splinter of Hatred{/c}, there is a {c_number}50%{/c} chance to spawn a second {c_important}War's Bounty Chest{/c}.
